axioms: The standard a piece is tested against must be a sealed, independent artifact (the acceptance-criteria block captured as an immutable run artifact), handed verbatim to the validator — never re-derivable or editable by the tier that produced the work, or the maker punches his own standard mark.

Assay is not appraisal: the plan-conformance verdict returns a per-criterion pass/fail against the sealed standard and must be structurally distinct from flux-drive's own review findings; one failed criterion defaces the hallmark (blocks advancement) regardless of how good the review looks.

A lawful hallmark carries a full chain of accountable punches: plan_execution_outcome must stamp separable provenance (author model, executor model, validator model, per-criterion counts, escalation count) so a later pass-rate drift is attributable to a specific (author_tier, executor_tier) pair, not an anonymous aggregate.

The assayer must itself be periodically tried against a sealed reference (Trial of the Pyx): nothing in the plan ever re-validates the validator tier's per-criterion judgments against ground truth, so a systematically lenient opus inflates the pass-rate that gates autonomy, undetectably.

Sub-standard work is defaced, not silently resubmitted: a failed dispatch must leave a durable defacement record and must not re-enter the stream to the same tier to be re-presented until it slips through.

The assay sample must be representative of the whole piece: the machine-checkable criteria must cover the plan's load-bearing surface, not a token scrape that lets a substantially non-conforming execution pass.
primitives: sealed standard held in trust (immutable acceptance-criteria artifact)
assay-not-appraisal (per-criterion conformance verdict distinct from review score)
Trial of the Pyx (audit-the-assayer / who validates the validator)
defacement vs silent resubmission (durable failure record)
forgery of the standard mark (executor/session model shaping its own pass criteria)
failure_mode: Owns criteria-as-sealed-independent-artifact, verdict-vs-appraisal separation, provenance-stamping-for-attribution, and audit-the-auditor; does NOT own tier-to-task allocation or master-substitution authority (swordsmith's territory), nor flow-volume, overflow, oscillation, or load-shedding (hydraulic's territory).

Sees the pass-rate metric only as a hallmark requiring attributable provenance and an audited office (integrity/attribution), not as a gauge requiring dredging/retention cadence (hydraulic) or unbiased statistical attribution (eval-calibration); expresses metric risk through the custody/audit metaphor, not the sample-size or confound frame.

Two-strikes escalation seen solely through the defacement facet (was the failed piece durably marked so it cannot silently re-enter) — not whether the escalated attempt changes the hand (swordsmith) or whether the ladder oscillates (hydraulic).
